title: Envelope: work_request (v2)
description: A work request carrying the v1 shape plus attachments[]: bytes moving WITH the request, addressed by digest, without implying a contract pin or a fulfilled deliver. P5's binding lands on this same file (D3).

to.description: Exchange type (X class, not decision): exactly one target system.

binding.description: P5 D1/Q2: what this artifact IS and whether it can be adopted or pinned — the field the XW-axon-20260801-vet6 incident had to write by hand as a fenced `key = value` block because work_request carried none. Either the literal `none` (T2: a producer declaring itself non-binding, load-bearing on the reader's side too, so nobody pins it), or the four declarations the incident's block spelled out. Absence is `undeclared`, distinct from a declared `none` (P-1) — this field is optional, not required.

artifact_class.description: What kind of thing this is, author's own vocabulary — e.g. non_binding_review.

compatibility_status.description: The compatibility claim being made, or "none" to make no claim at all.

adoptable.description: Whether `a2a contract adopt` may target the reviewed artifact.

runtime_pinnable.description: Whether a consumer may pin a runtime dependency against it.

allOf.description: T2's asymmetry: a `compatibility_status: none` claim inside the long form must be as unadoptable and unpinnable as the bare `none` sentinel, or the long form reopens the escape hatch T2 names — the sentinel and the long form must not disagree.

expires_at.description: When the retention lapses, absolute. Written by the tool at attach time; absent under retention: pinned. A duration alone is a RECIPE and a reader has no anchor to apply it to — nothing records when the bytes were attached, so a reader computing a lapse date from `created` would produce a confidently wrong one. The date is the fact; carry it.
